purpose: HWIN NEV16 true SRAM heads/attrs, precomputed due, original exact output edges

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_mu_hwin #(.NSLOT(47), .NEV(16), .NEP(4), .NRT(2), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/unit/dsdv_mu_mem.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/unit/dsdv_mu_hwin.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: hwin_exact
bench.min_count_regex: ^MUWIN starts (\d+) fires \d+ expected \d+ K \d+ t_mf 0000 hslot 0000 hwin 00$

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_hwin/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_hwin/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_hwin --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_mu_hwin --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x16_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: CODEX HWIN structural SRAM redesign: 16 independent event payload SRAMs (63b due+pos+user) with independent attribute SRAMs; gap and retire timestamp in SRAM. 64x16 true1R1W macros banked84total, registered write ports and previous-write forwarding. Due precomputed at record, final comparator registered due==tm+1. Binary shadow address pointers drive only bank read pins. Kept reset-distinct identity copies <=16entries, per-event reset regions. Remaining parallel identities1457b; fd752bits are fired-state vectors. No extra output edge or change to D>=nw+2. Inactive events enabled only by offset bootword; parameter-free die master16rows. Outline pin/halo constrained475.2x432, macros on43.2grid with10.8halo.
